feedback_given: Your diagnosis of primary hypothyroidism is spot on, considering Meera's symptoms of fatigue and weight gain despite no change in eating habits.
To further confirm this diagnosis, it would have been essential to assess her deep tendon reflexes, as hypothyroidism can cause delayed relaxation of reflexes.
Additionally, ordering thyroid function tests, including TSH and free T4, would have provided crucial laboratory evidence to support your diagnosis.
You also could have considered ordering Anti-TPO antibodies to investigate the possibility of an autoimmune cause, such as Hashimoto's thyroiditis.
